visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all seven final portable frames against the public-domain Qualla Hinnerk exterior, creator-released Rohan sign/street originals and Highsmith Room 306 detail. The two-storey room frontage, angled jog and return, cream windows and mint doors, rectangular balcony rails, external stairs, canopy and wreath are recognizable. Yellow oval, five white MOTEL roundels, green posts, lower board and red arrow distinguish the sign. The arrow now has a thin closed body and remains visible from behind. Hidden rear attachment surface, small sign lettering and room spacing remain generalized.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Actually inspected all seven final shared-material views including the north-up mapped overlay. Concrete, sandstone, painted metal and roof bindings load with metric UVs. The frontage follows the independently mapped west balcony polygon, rather than the whole modern museum envelope. The flat fixture checks transforms and unload; portable and context views retain independent source terrain. No photograph is a texture. Ground, placement and cameras remain unchanged.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected all nineteen current frames across lighting, distance, economy/high modes, front/back, silhouette and four forced detail levels. Every frame identifies actual current asset/runtime/detail bytes. Long two-storey frontage, jog, return and tall sign remain recognizable at distance; close views retain room rhythm, rail pattern, stairs and wreath. The closed red arrow survives back views. Synthetic context houses are style fixtures, not Memphis parcels.

geographicReview.notes: The native balcony feature 35185917602225 independently controls the west-facing frontage within combined museum feature 35184467221497. The main facade spans approximately 42.57 m with an angled jog and short northern return. The 9 m hidden rear depth is an interpretation, not surveyed museum geometry. Heading -106.67 degrees, anchor, +X south-southwest/+Z west-northwest, courtyard reference [0,8], source terrain and all cameras remain unchanged. The preserved 4225 Terrarium samples use the 78.5267 m host datum; -3.8 m rear foundation closures span the prior -3.443004..0.018893 m footprint relief, while front platform/sign closures reach -1.2 m. The schematic donor map is excluded. Coarse terrain and generalized map controls do not confer survey accuracy; footprint suppression stays off.

fidelityReview.scope: Preserved motel exterior, balcony/stairs, memorial wreath and roadside sign; later museum, opposite rooming house, interiors and historic vehicles excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: All 33 fresh current renders compared against four actually inspected public-domain originals. Started with the cleared Qualla Hinnerk exterior; Rohan creator-released sign/street photographs fill the cropped-sign gap, and Highsmith explicitly dedicated Room 306 detail confirms the railing, door, curtain divisions, soffit and wreath. A real one-sided red-arrow defect was repaired with a 0.12 m closed plate. Hidden rear closure, exact room widths, fine typography, message text, hardware and reverse sign artwork remain estimates. The two earlier CC photos and rights-unverified schematic donor map are excluded from current imagery approval. Photographs are local comparison inputs and never runtime textures.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels pass strict geometry/material/download checks and were inspected: 748/3975/7564/7564 triangles and 1/5/5/5 draws. Actual imported Float32 meshes pass 522 room-band roof/void probes and eight sign probes at each level, including front and back ray hits on the physical red arrow with front-side materials. The 9 m room-band depth is documented interpretation; these scoped probes are not a global mesh-distance measurement.

geometryValidation.notes: Raw source/skyline and actual imported Float32 meshes pass finite-attribute, nondegeneracy and winding/normal checks. The red arrow is now closed geometry, adding ten triangles to the authored full and skyline meshes. Scene/ground files remain byte-identical to the prior freeze; all functional frame coordinates and cameras are unchanged. Exact scoped regeneration, normal import verification, strict detail/material checks, four schemas, six runtime pack members and repeated 30-tick state hashes pass. No independent Khronos certificate is claimed.
